originals: Amanda small down for losing Rupert
Amanda on "Rupert wasn't caught, Ortiz's android was found"
Amanda after losing Rupert with Partners solved
Whether Amanda drops when Rupert got away but the Partners deviant was found
entries.question: On a run where Rupert got away in The Nest (or Connor saved Hank) and Connor survived, what Amanda arrow showed at the start of the garden walk: none, small down, or large down? And had Connor found Ortiz's android in Partners on that run?
entries.why: template (transcript.txt lines 13-35) gives no arrow when Partners succeeded and only LargeDown when both failed; the wiki chapter page line 62 ('Failure to catch Rupert in The Nest (Connor didn't die) down') and Relationship Stat give a small down, possibly stacked on the large down; the reliability log says the template's arrows on failure outcomes were wrong twice. Benchmark C11z: 0 or -2

originals: What ends WAIT FOR HANK?
Which action ends WAIT FOR HANK
Which action brings Hank out: the gun, the photo, or both; and whether other things can be looked at after the gun
entries.question: While Hank was getting dressed, after Connor looked at the revolver on the kitchen floor, could he still go and look at Cole's photo (or anything else) before Hank came out?
entries.why: PowerPyx: 'keep the gun for last, checking it will end the mission'; wiki: the photo 'will trigger Hank is Ready, so do this last'; a PowerPyx reader: 'I've been able to check other things after checking Hank's gun … a combination of both'. Benchmark C11m ends the wait on the gun, so a model that checks the gun first loses knowsCole (The Bridge, Night of the Soul, the Tower)

originals: Hank down on the bathroom? (§8 item 1)
Hank down on the bathroom? (recap)
Whether Hank drops on the bathroom when Connor survived The Nest
entries.answer: Only if Connor died in The Nest. The template nests 'RelationName.Hank | RelationType.SmallDown' inside the Death unlock 'Connor died in The Nest' on waking Hank; the wiki lists the Hank down only as 'Connor died in "The Nest"'; a PowerPyx reader confirms no drop otherwise. PowerPyx's unconditional 'Hank▼' is outranked
entries.source: /tmp/flowcharts/ch18/transcript.txt lines 270-283; wiki.txt line 68; pp.html reader comment

entries.topic: Calm the dog: asked vs exhausted
originals: Calm Hank's Dog bug
Whether CALM HANK'S DOG needs the DOG exchange exhausted, not just asked
entries.answer: Asking is enough. The template's lock is 'Asked Hank about his dog'; in Waiting for Hank the DOG button is a single option (ch12 template: OPTION "[DOG]", Lock 'Analyzed the dog hairs on the chair', Hank SmallUp) whose one exchange already gives the name, so there is nothing further to exhaust. The lone reader's failed attempt is the lowest-ranked source

originals: Shower round labels
Whether ADVICE is ever offered in the shower, and whether SOLUTION gets a reply
entries.answer: The template's shower prompt renders four buttons, RATIONAL, AGGRESSIVE, SOLUTION, PRAGMATIC, and SOLUTION has no Hank reply; ADVICE exists only as a string with no line (X0602C/HANKHOUSE/SHOWERING/PC/CHOICEGROUP01/ADVICE). No source mentions a timer on this prompt; the benchmark models no dialogue timeouts anywhere
entries.source: transcript.txt shower choice group (lines ~300-325); strings.txt line 253
